tools.name: find_dinners
tools.description: Find upcoming The Dinner Table Club dinner parties for strangers, filtered by city and date range. Each result has the restaurant, neighborhood, local date and time, price per person (dinner included), whether seats are left, and a link to the event page where tickets are sold. Cities: New York (NYC

tools.name: get_dinner_details
tools.description: Get full details for one The Dinner Table Club dinner returned by find_dinners: the event description with the restaurant and menu as listed, plus answers to common questions (coming solo, age, what the ticket includes, dietary needs, bringing a friend, cancellations).

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities where The Dinner Table Club hosts dinners, whether each is live or coming soon, and how many dinners are on the calendar.
